First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual.
Check
Look at @rbgoakland the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Red Bike & Green Community Rides group ride

A collective of Black urban cyclists that has ridden during Oakland's First Friday since 2007. The Friday ride draws a younger crowd; the second Saturday ride is family-friendly, with kids and grandparents. Both leave from the Lake Merritt Pergola. Routes stop at Black-owned businesses.
